title: Sentry control: barrel spin, mouse aims and Space fires, tank pad on the phone, ?story=N deep link, LAN dev server
context: Owner: the barrel amount in PoV is right, add the rotation; separate move and shoot (mouse aims, Space fires; on mobile the same controls as the tank); a deep link for phone tests; commit and push.
outcome: towerlooks keeps the Rotor's ROTOR node as a pivot and td-tab winds it up to 34 rad/s while the trigger is held and down after (one line). sentry-pilot: a left click requests pointer lock and mouse movement aims (movementX/Y when locked, drag deltas otherwise); the left button no longer fires; Space and the tank pad's fire button hold the trigger; the pad's side zones turn the mount at 1.6 rad/s; pad clicks never reach the tank. The bastion view is no longer forced to third on the mobile shell while piloting. readStoryQuery accepts ?story=N as the deep link (story world, stage N, threat 0.35, heart none, cine 0) and the lab's play link uses it. scripts/serve.mjs takes --host for LAN tests. Acceptance boots the deep link and checks the empty heart, running beats and hidden manual.
alternatives: Keep left-click firing alongside Space: rejected, the owner asked for separate move and shoot.
